name: Ja & Masha
source:
The game is a DLC to the main game "[url=/v41181]Postupivshij v PTUTI[/url]". In the novel, you will spend time with your girlfriend Masha. You will play games together, explore rooms, discuss topics, look for something to eat, etc.
